aggregation: sum subscription-wide eligible classic Consumption apps, calendar month-to-date UTC

collector.cadence: hourly initially; shorten only if burst risk warrants added cost
collector.source: Azure Monitor metrics API, not sampled request logs
collector.emptyOrMissingMetric: unknown; notify monitoring failure, never assume zero
collector.notification: recipient/action group unresolved; do not create or send
collector.dedup: persist threshold crossings keyed by subscription/month/metric/threshold

notes: Alerts do not stop usage or billing.
Do not use a rolling 24-hour metric alert as a monthly free-tier alarm.
Free grant is shared across eligible apps in subscription; app-only accounting can undercount.
Cost data and notifications can lag. SQL AutoPause does not cap Functions/storage/network costs.
